prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 93.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 70.9%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Command Cheat Sheet Screen: Adds a dedicated interactive controls guide screen before finishing setup, teaching users shortcut commands for hiding, dragging, and interacting with their desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Sync Account Verification Warning Badge: Displays a prominent cloud security badge explaining how account creation binds pets to user profiles across app launches. (why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Photo Sample Pose Reference Carousel: Adds a photo sample guide carousel directly into photo upload to visually demonstrate optimal lighting and angles for custom pets. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation fails or results look wrong, and adoption step conversion drops to 71.1%.)
3: [sign_in, incentive] Account Retrieval Pet Status Banner: Adds an explicit account recovery highlight banner on sign_in emphasizing instant restoration of previously created pets. (why: 8 support emails mentioned existing pet loss or reset upon sign in; sign_in step conversion is currently 77.4%.)
4: [finish, new_screen] Pre-Finish Desktop Dock Position Selector Screen: Adds a screen before completion letting users choose where their companion will anchor on their screen (e.g. bottom right dock or system tray). (why: Prevents desktop visibility bugs and post-onboarding confusion around finding or controlling pets.)
5: [choose_path, wait_info] Onboarding Stage Audio-Visual Progress Bar: Enables step counters and estimated time badges on early story and path selection screens to set clear expectations. (why: Overall completion rate is only 28.5%; setting clear progress context upfront improves completion throughput.)

scores.note: Adds screen friction at finish step despite clarifying desktop pet controls.

Helps users pass photo upload step where conversion drops to 71.1%.
